P1.claim: Of the next >= 5 newly transliterated |M153+X| or |M153+M342| tokens (any source), >= 3 sit on the last signed line and >= 2 of those are unnumbered
P1.kill: <= 1 of 5 on the last signed line

P2.claim: No new |M153+M342| / |M153+X| token stands in a numbered capacity (C-system) entry

P3.claim: Sealing is NOT predicted by the M153 closing line once the PES0329/PES0334 series is counted once: new tablets with the closing line are sealed at the rate of short M157-headed tablets of their volume, not above
P3.kill: >= 4 of the next 5 such tablets sealed by distinct seals

P4.claim: Any new tablet impressed with PES0334 (boat) carries |M153+X| or |M153+M342| on its last line; any new PES0329 tablet carries |M153+M342|
P4.kill: 2 new PES0334/PES0329 tablets without either compound

P5.claim: The M153 closing partner stays office-like: new tokens bring at most 1 new partner value per 5 tokens (V/n <= 0.2)
P5.kill: >= 3 new partner values among the next 5 closing M153 compounds
